seoTitle: Christmas Gifts for Him Under £50 UK 2026: 8 Ideas
title: Christmas gifts for him under £50: 8 checked ideas for 2026
description: Eight Christmas 2026 gifts for him under £50, from a half-price Versace aftershave to a Philips OneBlade, with prices checked on 6 November.
intro:
**Our top Christmas gift for him under £50 is Versace L'Homme 100ml eau de toilette at £39, half its usual £78 at LOOKFANTASTIC.** For something practical, the Philips OneBlade 360 is £39.34 on Amazon, and a JBL Go 5 speaker is £34 at Currys.

Every price below comes from sources dated 6 November 2026. Aftershave and gift sets tend to sell out rather than get cheaper, so buy those now. Tech and gadgets may dip a little on Black Friday (27 November), and we've said where it's worth waiting.

deals.name: Versace L'Homme eau de toilette 100ml
deals.note: Half price on a big 100ml bottle of a classic, slightly powdery men's scent. A safe pick for a dad or older brother who likes something smart rather than sporty.

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360
deals.note: One tool that trims, edges and shaves, with a flexible head that follows the jaw. Good for anyone who keeps stubble or a short beard.

deals.name: Montblanc Explorer Platinum eau de parfum
deals.note: A fresh, woody scent from a name people recognise, for £31. Our source didn't give the bottle size at this price, so check it on the page before you buy.

deals.name: JBL Go 5 portable Bluetooth speaker
deals.note: Pocket-sized and waterproof, for the shower, the garage or a weekend away. It's only a small saving, so it could dip further on Black Friday.

deals.name: Renpho massage gun
deals.note: For runners, gym-goers or anyone with stiff shoulders from a desk job. Renpho sells a few models, so check the one you pick is the £32.24 deal.

deals.name: LEGO Marvel Advent Calendar
deals.note: 24 small Marvel builds for a grown-up fan, given before 1 December. Lego calendars sell out, so don't wait for Black Friday.

deals.name: Calvin Klein CK IN2U Him eau de toilette 150ml
deals.note: A light, easy everyday scent in a large bottle for £21. Good for a younger brother, a teenager or a Secret Santa with a bigger budget.

deals.name: JLab Go Air Pop wireless earbuds
deals.note: Basic, light earbuds for the gym or commute, for under £20. Not for audiophiles, but a sensible spare pair that won't matter if they get lost.

body:
## How to choose a gift for him under £50

Start with what he already uses. A man who has worn the same aftershave for ten years will be happier with a bigger bottle of it than with something new. Someone who shaves or trims every day will use a better grooming tool far more than a gadget that sits in a drawer. If you don't know his tastes, go for something with a clear use: a speaker, earbuds or a massage gun.

Under £50 is the price band where brand names matter most. Half-price designer aftershave looks far more generous than its price, while cheap no-name gadgets often look cheap. That's why most of our picks are recognisable brands at a reduced price, not budget alternatives.

## Which gifts are worth buying now

**Aftershave:** buy now. Big-name men's fragrances are already 25% to 50% off at LOOKFANTASTIC, Boots, The Perfume Shop and Very, and the most popular sizes go out of stock in December. Versace L'Homme at £39 for 100ml and Burberry Hero eau de parfum at £53 for 50ml (a little over budget, at Boots) are both strong prices. Our [perfume gift set guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/) covers boxed sets too.

**Grooming:** the Philips OneBlade 360 at just under £40 is a good price. It has sometimes been a few pounds cheaper in big sales, so it's fine to wait for Black Friday if you're not in a rush, but the saving will be small.

**Tech:** small speakers and earbuds get modest Black Friday cuts. The JBL Go 5 at £34 and JLab earbuds at £19.99 are fair now. If you'd like to spend a bit more, our [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the target prices.

**Advent calendars:** buy now. They're only useful before 1 December and sell out quickly. See our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/).

## Good prices to aim for

- Designer aftershave, 100ml eau de toilette: under £45 is good, under £40 is excellent
- Philips OneBlade 360: under £40
- JBL Go 5: £30 to £35
- Lego Marvel advent calendar: under £24

## When prices usually drop

Most gift prices bottom out in the week before Black Friday (27 November) and over Cyber Monday (30 November). After that, fragrance and gift sets start selling out, and prices on what's left often go back up until the Boxing Day sales. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's sale dates, and the [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) hub has ideas for everyone else on your list, including [Christmas gifts for her under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-her-under-50/) and [Secret Santa gifts under £10](/guides/secret-santa-gifts-under-10/).

### What is a good Christmas gift for a man under £50?

A bottle of designer aftershave he already likes is hard to beat, as many are half price in November. Practical grooming tools, like the Philips OneBlade, and small Bluetooth speakers are also popular.

### Should I buy Christmas presents before Black Friday?

For things that sell out, like fragrance, gift sets and advent calendars, yes. For gadgets and electricals, waiting until the week of 27 November may save a few pounds, especially at Amazon.

### Is half-price aftershave genuine?

At big retailers like Boots, LOOKFANTASTIC, The Perfume Shop and John Lewis, yes. Avoid marketplace sellers with prices far below everyone else, as fakes are common.

### When is the last order date for Christmas delivery?

Retailers usually publish these in early December, with standard delivery cut-offs around 18 to 20 December. Order sooner for anything that's selling well.
